changelog: v0.2.0: LOCKED_THRESHOLD 0.075 (Youden-J grid optimum on the n=98 primary set, inside the 100-fold envelope and bootstrap CI). Candidate 0.10 formally rejected and retained as historical record only.
v0.2.0: GATE_E_DESIGNATED_DECISION hardcoded (research-use screening hypothesis for the clinical-utility gate).
v0.2.0: NFE-3 result added -- within-fold multiple imputation on the full n=98 resolves Gate B5 as PASS_WITH_CAVEATS.
v0.2.0: NFE-1 result added -- s3<->CX3 crosswalk on TCGA-OV (n=529) FAILS the 0.80 surrogate criterion; CX-transfer route to Gate C closed on evidence; direct Macintyre quantification route named.
v0.2.0: RED baseline figure corrected to the measured 231 failing/erroring nodes (supersedes unverifiable 226).

intended_use.statement: Rank-orders patients by copy-number signature 3 exposure at diagnosis as a research-use resistance axis for cohort enrichment and hypothesis generation. Not for individual treatment decisions.
explicitly_not_supported: calibrated absolute risk of platinum resistance
intended_use.regulatory_status: Research Use Only. Not for diagnostic procedures.

feature.name: s3_diag
feature.definition: Macintyre 2018 copy-number signature 3 exposure, computed on the diagnosis-stage specimen
feature.framework_citation: Macintyre G, Goranova TE, De Silva D, et al. Nat Genet 50, 1262-1270 (2018). DOI 10.1038/s41588-018-0179-8
feature.forbidden_alias_rationale: COSMIC CN signatures and COSMIC SBS3 are different frameworks with different definitions. Reading a value from the wrong namespace is the defect recorded as contradiction C02 and must raise, not silently return None.
feature.feature_selection: none - single prespecified feature. No selection step exists, therefore no selection can leak.

scaling_denominator.rule: standard deviation of s3_diag over the PRIMARY analysis set (n=98), not over any covariate-complete subset
scaling_denominator.rationale: Contradiction C14: using the n=67 SD (0.139083) shifted the adjusted OR from 0.0252 to 0.0247-0.0199 depending on the other choices. Pinning the denominator removes that drift.

direction.sign_of_score: resistance score is monotone DECREASING in s3_diag
direction.auroc_orientation_note: With positive class = resistant and the raw s3 value as the score, AUROC < 0.5 is the expected and correct result. 0.2715 at n=98 is a protective direction, not a failed model.
source_attribution: Macintyre 2018: s3 is the BRCA1/2-related HRD axis and is positively prognostic
Smith 2023: s3 significantly LOWER in the primary resistant population at diagnosis

definitions.s3_diag_z: (s3_diag - mean(s3_diag over n=98)) / sd(s3_diag over n=98)
definitions.age_z: (age - mean(age over n=98)) / sd(age over n=98)
definitions.brca: brca_mut with missing treated as False
definitions.nlines: pd.to_numeric(num_lines, errors='coerce') then median-filled; '4+' becomes NaN then median

covariate_contract_for_adjusted_analyses.rationale: This is the exact archived specification. It is pinned so that any future re-run is comparable, not because it is the only defensible specification.

primary.penalization_rationale: 9 events in the covariate-complete set; maximum-likelihood logistic is unreliable and separation-prone at this event count
primary.preprocessing: standardisation fitted INSIDE each training fold only

parsimonious_vs_multivariable.evidence: OOF AUROC: M1 single feature 0.8747 (fold SD 0.0062); M3a clinical+s3 0.8752 (0.0182); M5 full 6-parameter 0.8372 (0.0303). Adding covariates does not improve discrimination and increases fold-to-fold variance. NFE-3 on the full n=98 under multiple imputation: M3a 0.7008 vs M0 0.5171 -- the multivariable model does not beat the s3-only raw-feature AUROC (0.7285) on the same denominator.
parsimonious_vs_multivariable.note: M3a has the best OOF AUPRC (0.4325 vs 0.4041) but at 4 parameters on 9 events. The parsimonious model is the candidate; M3a is retained as a prespecified secondary.

validation_protocol.leakage_guard: models.verify_no_leakage asserts that preprocessing parameters differ across folds; verified True for every fitted model

known_degeneracy.statement: For a single monotone feature, a fitted logistic is a monotone transform, so its within-fold AUROC equals 1 - AUROC(raw s3) to 1.11e-16 across 1000 folds. Cross-validation of this model adds no discrimination information.
known_degeneracy.implication: Cross-validation is still required the moment a threshold is chosen or a probability is emitted, and that is where this candidate fails (see calibration).

covariate_complete_subset.selection_warning: set98 -> set67 restriction is outcome-selective: Fisher OR 0.2821, p 0.0162, prevalence 0.1343 in vs 0.3548 out

nfe3_selection_bias_imputation.question: Does the M0 -> M3a incremental signal survive on the full n=98 when the 31 block-missing covariate sets are multiply imputed?
nfe3_selection_bias_imputation.method: IterativeImputer(sample_posterior=True), m=10 per fold, fitted INSIDE each training fold with outcome as predictor; held-out outcomes set to NaN; Firth estimator unchanged; identical 5x20 folds; Rubin pooling; KNNImputer(k=5) sensitivity
caveats: Rubin CI reflects CV-repeat and imputation variance, not full sampling uncertainty of the AUROC
complete-case delta (0.3525) was inflated by the outcome-selected subset; the transported estimate is smaller and remains positive

calibration.consequence: The slope CI spans 1 so widely that it is compatible with severe under- and over-fitting simultaneously. No probability may be emitted.

provenance.dataset: BriTROC-1 diagnosis primary analysis set (n=98, 20 resistant events, prevalence 0.2041)
provenance.analysis: Youden-J optimum over the prespecified grid [0.025..0.150] on out-of-fold predictions (J=0.4564); inside the 100-fold in-fold cutpoint envelope [0.0502, 0.0798] and the bootstrap cutpoint CI [0.0467, 0.2084]

rejected_candidate.provenance: UNSOURCED_IN_REPOSITORY - supplied by the directive, not found in any file on any ref
rejection_reasons: grid-optimal only on the n=67 subset and only via a zero false-negative cell
on the primary n=98 set it is dominated by 0.075 (J 0.429 vs 0.456)

threshold_record.status: LOCKED for research shadow scoring. The lock is a candidate lock, not a clinical threshold: it defines the shadow-scorer operating point and the Gate E screening hypothesis. Changing it requires a spec version bump plus a new provenance record.

gate_e_designated_decision.statement: Prioritize s3_diag <= 0.075 patients for non-platinum clinical-trial screening.
gate_e_designated_decision.nature: DESIGNATED_DECISION_FOR_UTILITY_EVALUATION - the decision whose clinical utility Gate E must test. It is a research-use screening hypothesis, not a live recommendation.
gate_e_designated_decision.direction_check: higher s3 = platinum sensitive, therefore LOW s3 flags likely resistance and prioritizes NON-platinum trials
gate_e_designated_decision.utility_question: Does screening on this rule enrich non-platinum trial cohorts for platinum-resistant patients enough to offset the 58% false-flag rate (fp=19 of 33 flagged at the lock on n=98)? Gate E answers this with a prospective utility design, not with this retrospective table.

nfe1_framework_crosswalk.question: Can Drews CX3 (or CX3-CX2) stand in for Macintyre s3 so CX-published cohorts could serve as Gate C external validation?
nfe1_framework_crosswalk.cohort: TCGA-OV, n=529 with both frameworks published by the originating labs (BriTROC-1 substitution recorded: segment profiles EGA-controlled, CX never published for BriTROC-1)
nfe1_framework_crosswalk.consequence: CX-transfer route to Gate C is CLOSED on evidence. Open route: direct Macintyre-framework quantification (CINSignatureQuantification supports the ovarian s1-s7 signatures natively) on public absolute CN profiles with outcomes (TCGA-OV ASCAT + TCGA-CDR platinum response; PCAWG-OV).

prohibitions: Do not convert any AUROC into a confidence, a probability, or a percentage certainty. AUROC 0.8807 does not mean 88% confidence and never will.
Do not emit a calibrated probability. Calibration slope CI is [0.34, 2.73] and Brier skill is -0.2762 versus predicting prevalence.
Do not describe this as a durable or independent biomarker. CLAIM_LEDGER.md row 9 prohibits that language and this work does not lift the prohibition.
Do not quote 0.8807 or 0.887 without n=67, 9 events, the statement that it is the reversed raw feature, and the selection warning.
Do not substitute the locked threshold without a version bump and provenance record.
Do not read the feature from any namespace other than the Macintyre 2018 7-signature framework.

Do not present a passing adversarial suite as a green repository: the backend baseline is RED with 231 failing or erroring nodes (measured 2026-08-19 over 1,873 collected nodes; supersedes the earlier unverifiable 226).

novelty_position.statement: This re-derives a published copy-number HRD axis (Macintyre s3) with an independent implementation. That is method validation, not biomarker discovery.
novelty_position.what_is_new_here: The measured demonstration that s3 is NOT a restatement of the BRCA/HR mutation axis in this cohort: BRCA mutation status is uncorrelated with s3 exposure (point-biserial r 0.0912, p 0.372 at n=98) and carries essentially no discrimination for registration platinum resistance on its own (AUROC 0.4724 at n=98; 0.5287 at n=67), while s3 adds delta AUROC 0.6571 [0.4713, 0.8257] on top of it.

deployment.flag_off_behaviour: No S3-derived value reaches any response field.
deployment.flag_on_behaviour: Every S3 output carries research_only=true and intended_use=RANKING_ONLY; no probability, no action_recommendation, no treatment_recommendation. The locked threshold 0.075 is applied by default and reported as threshold_applied plus below_locked_threshold; the Gate E designated decision string is carried as documentation.
deployment.provenance_enforcement: The scorer refuses to load unless the source-data SHA256 and the spec version both match the recorded values.
